name: worktree-cleaner
description: Interactive Antigravity MCP App & visual inspector for Git worktrees left behind by AI coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Trae). Recall what each worktree changed, slim caches, push branches, and safely move stale worktrees to Trash.
suggestedPrompts: Open Worktree Cleaner to inspect and clean up my stale Git worktrees
Scan all my Codex and Claude Code worktrees and show how much disk space I can safely reclaim
Check which worktrees have uncommitted changes or unpushed commits before cleaning them
